subject.title: Feature: configurable LLM retry with backoff on transient errors (overloaded/529)

question: Should OpenClaw expose configurable main LLM retry/backoff policy, and if so should it live at agent defaults, provider config, or a narrower failover policy seam?
rationale: The requested behavior adds new config and provider/fallback semantics in an area AGENTS.md marks as compatibility-sensitive, and it overlaps open retry/fallback PRs with different scopes.

options.title: Keep as canonical API decision
options.body: Use this issue to decide the retry config shape before accepting runtime wiring from any linked PR.

options.title: Narrow to built-in retry only
options.body: Reject public retry config for now and only accept bounded default behavior for proven overloaded/no-fallback bugs.

options.title: Defer to linked PR after proof
options.body: Close only after an active linked PR lands a compatible runtime implementation with upgrade and behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Keep as canonical API decision
recommendation.body: Use this issue to decide the retry config shape before accepting runtime wiring from any linked PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent timeline activity make steipete the strongest routing candidate for provider/config product direction.
